'''Gungan bouillabaisse''' was a very strong and thick [[Soup/Legends|soup]] named after the [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During the [[Battle of Drongar]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Den Dhur]] compared the smell of a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the planet [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] to that of Gungan bouillabaisse.<ref name="MedStar II" /> He once again recognized the smell at the [[Ploughtekal Market]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CorNights II">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The soup was first mentioned in ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', a novel written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]], which was published in [[2004]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
